description: Source code for a Nordic Semiconductor NRF LED matrix display driver using Zephyr RTOS, involving GPIO, PWM, and timer configurations for controlling LED matrices.

methods.name: set_pin
methods.description: Sets a GPIO pin high or low based on active state and pin info.

methods.name: api_blanking_on
methods.description: Turns off display blanking, stopping timer and disabling rows and columns.

methods.name: api_blanking_off
methods.description: Turns on display blanking, restarting timer and enabling display updates.

methods.name: api_get_framebuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to the frame buffer.

methods.name: api_set_brightness
methods.description: Adjusts pixel brightness and updates frame buffer accordingly.

methods.name: api_set_pixel_format
methods.description: Sets pixel format; supports monochrome format.

methods.name: api_set_orientation
methods.description: Sets display orientation; supports normal orientation.

methods.name: api_get_capabilities
methods.description: Provides display capabilities such as resolution and supported formats.

methods.name: move_to_next_pixel
methods.description: Advances pixel mask and data for bitwise pixel processing.

methods.name: api_write
methods.description: Writes pixel data to the frame buffer within specified rectangle.

methods.name: prepare_pixel_pulse
methods.description: Prepares PWM or GPIOTE pulse for a specific pixel and channel.

methods.name: timer_irq_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for timer events, manages pixel refresh cycles.

methods.name: instance_init
methods.description: Initializes display driver instance, configures GPIO, timer, PWM, and interrupts.
